edition_policy: Only current and fixed legacy remain visible. No intermediate profile or new old-spelling aliases.

rationale.klarion: User adopts 军号, the established term for a signaling bugle. 军 emphasizes typical military use without changing the original broader PIV gloss or figurative uses. Body strokes 15 to 11; share 军 and 号, remove unique 嘹.

migration_notice: Only klarion changes from 嘹 to 军号. No identifiers or existing owners change. Fixed legacy, alias content and two visible editions are preserved.
